purpose: Form CRA-4 is used by a company to furnish the cost audit report and other documents to the Central Government using the XBRL taxonomy.
who: A company required to furnish cost audit report and other documents to the Central Government
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Prepare the cost audit report and other required documents.
Ensure the files use the XBRL taxonomy given in Annexure-III for financial years commencing on or after 1st April, 2014.
File the report and other documents using e-Form CRA-4.
checklist: Other documents required under sub-section (6) of section 148 of the Act
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
